name: ButtonSet

props.name: fluid
props.description: fluid: button set resize to the size of the container up to a maximum dependant on the number of buttons. Overrides `stacked` property.

props.name: stacked
props.description: Specify the button arrangement of the set (vertically stacked or horizontal)

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon ButtonSet rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
